_comment: Consequence seeds. Every resolved thread spawns from here, which is the mechanism that makes the campaign never-ending.

success.title: The Crew Someone Else Hired
success.summary: The team that lost this contract wants to know who took it, and they are better funded now.

success.title: A Favour Called Due
success.summary: Someone helped without being asked. That was not generosity, it was an invoice.

success.title: What Was Actually In The Package
success.summary: The crew delivered it. Nobody explained it. Someone is dying over it now.

success.title: Repeat Business
success.summary: The client was satisfied. The next job is bigger and the deniability is thinner.

success.title: Recognised
success.summary: A runner was made on this job by someone from their old life.

success.title: An Analyst Notices A Pattern
success.summary: Three jobs, one methodology. Somebody in a corporate basement has started a file.

failure.title: Burned On The Street
failure.summary: Word gets around. Rates drop, fixers hesitate, and someone is taking credit for the crew's failure.

failure.title: The Client Wants Restitution
failure.summary: Money was taken and nothing was delivered. That balance gets settled one way or another.

failure.title: The Cleanup Contract
failure.summary: Someone will pay the crew to fix what the crew broke. The irony is not lost on anyone.

failure.title: Left Behind
failure.summary: Something of the crew's stayed at the site. It has been found.

failure.title: The One Who Didn't Make It Out
failure.summary: A contact, an ally, or a bystander paid for the crew's failure. Their people know.

mixed.title: Half A Job Is Still A Job
mixed.summary: The client pays partial and expects the rest. The rest just got harder.

mixed.title: The Detail Nobody Explains
mixed.summary: Something at the site did not fit, and the client goes quiet whenever it comes up.

mixed.title: A Bridge Half Burned
mixed.summary: One faction is grateful and another is not, and they share a border.

mixed.title: The Cost Of Doing Business
mixed.summary: Something the crew cared about was spent to get out. It does not come back.

faction_retaliation.title: Audit
faction_retaliation.summary: {faction} has assigned an investigator. Not muscle -- an investigator. That is worse.

faction_retaliation.title: The Bounty
faction_retaliation.summary: {faction} has quietly funded a bounty. Every desperate street operator in the sprawl now has a reason to look twice.

faction_retaliation.title: Pressure On The Edges
faction_retaliation.summary: {faction} cannot find the crew, so they are leaning on the crew's contacts instead.

faction_retaliation.title: Corporate Response Team
faction_retaliation.summary: {faction} has stopped being subtle. A team has been authorised and given the crew's faces.

faction_retaliation.title: Legal Instrument
faction_retaliation.summary: {faction} has filed something with extraterritorial teeth. The crew is now a jurisdiction problem.

downtime: a contact calls with something they should not know
a package arrives at the safehouse with no sender
one of the crew's fake SINs gets flagged in a routine sweep
an old job resurfaces in the news, reported entirely wrong
a neighbour asks a question that is far too specific
the fixer wants a meeting and will not say why
money that should have cleared has not cleared
somebody has been asking about the crew at their usual bar
